data.ruling: The refutation stands. The figure says "no alternate with the same body is in the jlcparts copy", and that is false. The copy holds two same-body 3.3 uH Coilcraft rows. XAL5030-332MEB (C2927046) is the same part as the -332MEC: the datasheet defines packaging code B as "less than full reel" and C as a 7-inch machine-ready reel. XGL5030-332MEC (C3911724) is the XGL series in the 5030 size. The rest of the figure is correct. The electrical values match the datasheet row "XAL5030-332ME_": 3.3 uH, DCR (DC resistance) 21.20 mOhm typical and 23.30 mOhm maximum, Isat (saturation current) 8.7 A. Live JLCPCB stock for C5342047 is stockCount 117 and canPresaleNumber 103. Digi-Key has no listing. The conclusion "there is no second source" still holds, because neither alternate passes rule 4 live. C2927046 has stockCount 0 and canPresaleNumber 0. C3911724 has stockCount 0 and canPresaleNumber 0. The copy's stock of 1 for C3911724 is not a count (rule 3). Digi-Key returns 404 for both XAL5030-332MEC and XAL5030-332MEB. The false statement concerns the rule-5 second-source search for this function. It is not about the part's lifecycle, maker allowlist or LCSC identity, so the scope is function. The corrected figure reads: "the jlcparts copy holds XAL5030-332MEB (C2927046) and XGL5030-332MEC (C3911724), and both have 0 stock at JLCPCB on 2026-09-28".
